title_sq: Magazine ne shitje ne autostraden Tirane-Durres (ID 4181065)
description_sq:
Ne autostraden Tirane-Durres, shitet magazine prane rruge dytesore, me hipoteke me siperfaqe totale 2500m². Siperfaqa e ndertimit eshte 1065m², nga te cilat 1000m² eshte hapsire e shfrytezueshme dhe 65m² siperfaqe zyrash. 1435m² eshte siperfaqe e shfrytezueshme per parkim. Magazina eshte open space dhe me lartesi 10m.
Magazina ka dhe nje shtese me sip 285m2 dhe 6 m e larte anesore.
Eshte e ndertuar me tulle dhe mbulimi eshte konstruksion metalik. Pershtatet per fabrika, punishte etj.
Shitet 1.2 milion euro.
title_en: Store for sale on the Tirana-Durres highway (ID 4181065)
description_en: On the Tirana-Durres highway, a warehouse for sale near a secondary road, with a mortgage with a total area of ​​2500m². The construction area is 1065m², of which 1000m² is usable space and 65m² office space. 1435m² is usable surface for parking. The warehouse is open space and 10m high. The warehouse also has an extension with a surface of 285 m2 and 6 m high side walls. It is built with bricks and the roof is a metal structure. Suitable for factories, workshops, etc. For sale 1.2 million euros.
